goal: Dynamic testing gate: what the running-application scan must pass before a release.
use: Dynamic testing gate: what the running-application scan must pass before a release. Use when a release is deployed to a test environment.

steps.note: Confirm the target. The scan runs against a test environment that matches production.
Set the rule. High findings block promotion to production.
Confirm authentication. The scan is authenticated so it reaches protected pages.
Check the window. The scan runs after each deployment, not only at release.
Report. The target, the rule, the result and the owner of each finding.
